answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn reputation, then slash that stake if it is caught double-claiming rewards or coordinating duplicate identities. A reviewer can compare claims across a knoll of tasks, treating each task as a vertex in a shared graph and looking for a grove of accounts with suspiciously identical behavior. Spinning up more names no longer creates free influence: the attacker must lock real capital in every identity and risks losing it when the cluster is exposed.
